verdict.rationale: The SDK is a library you run in your own process via the Runner class. It is documented as provider-agnostic, supporting 100+ non-OpenAI LLMs with providers selectable per agent, and its default tracing to OpenAI can be turned off with an environment variable. Several built-in tools (web search, file search, code interpreter, hosted MCP) are OpenAI-managed, so a fully vendor-independent setup gives those up. missing for 10: explicit documentation of running against self-hosted or local models, a documented fully offline or air-gapped deployment, independent hands-on corroboration of vendor-free operation, and self-hostable equivalents for the OpenAI-managed tools.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run my agents entirely on my own infrastructure with no dependence on the vendor's platform

citations.quote: It is provider-agnostic, supporting the OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions APIs, as well as 100+ other LLMs.
You can globally disable tracing by setting the env var `OPENAI_AGENTS_DISABLE_TRACING=1`
Select providers per run or per agent and review feature differences
